body.objective: Provide a backward-compatible valid-JSON serialization surface for IvTaylorMat; the current ivtm_serialize envelope is JSON-shaped but emits exact p/q rational tokens without quotes, so standard JSON parsers reject passing transport artifacts.
body.stop_condition: Add a versioned deterministic serializer, preferably ivtm_serialize_json_v2, whose output is accepted directly by a standards-compliant JSON parser. Preserve generator, degree, rows, columns, refusal code, all exact rational coefficient matrices, and every IEEE-754 remainder endpoint bit pattern. Encode exact rationals canonically as strings such as "-3/7" and endpoint bits as fixed-width hexadecimal strings, with no locale dependence. Keep the existing ivtm_serialize behavior available or provide an explicit migration path so pinned Phase-3 consumers at Tango commit 972aa4337 remain reproducible. Add C/native byte-equivalence tests, direct JSON parse tests, round-trip reconstruction, malformed/nonfinite refusal tests, deterministic-order tests, and mutations for an unquoted rational, reordered coefficient matrices, dropped refusal code, changed generator, and decimalized exact coefficient.
body.current_gate: Valid machine-readable Taylor2 transport handoff without consumer-side token rewriting
body.forbid: no silent change to the pinned v1 byte stream; no decimal approximation of exact rationals; no omission or normalization of signed endpoint bit patterns; no parser that accepts arbitrary non-JSON syntax; no physics-specific fields or Schwarzschild equations in mathlib
body.resource_hint: Reproduction: a passing Phase-3 q0 infinity-plane child prints coefficients such as 1/3 inside the object emitted by ivtm_serialize; json.loads rejects the unquoted token. The current physics wrapper uses a narrowly scoped regex that quotes only signed integer p/q tokens and pins the child source hash. That is an acceptable frozen-consumer workaround, not the desired reusable API.
notes: This is a serialization/API papercut; it does not weaken the passing Taylor transport or request a rerun.
Prefer a new v2 function and schema over mutating v1 while active consumers pin 972aa4337.
The valid-JSON gate should parse the exact emitted bytes, not a separately constructed test object.
